decision: Establish an auditable open-source discovery and adoption process while preserving the existing Cloudflare Workers, D1, versioned-asset, security, rights, and zero-budget boundaries.
invariants: No third-party dependency is added by this documentation-only contract.
No upstream source code, creative content, user data, secrets, or credentials are copied.
Every adopted dependency requires exact-version licence and transitive-dependency review.
Existing Cloudflare Workers and D1 runtime architecture remains authoritative.
No new paid hosting, subscription, proprietary API, or mandatory paid feature is introduced.
Existing package manifests and lockfiles are not changed.
No production deployment or D1 mutation occurs.
acceptance: Every new and changed documentation path has exactly one registered owner.
The ownership governance check passes with an ADR and feature contract in the same PR.
The candidate catalog distinguishes free software from free hosting and free service quotas.
Candidates with unverified licences or incompatible hosting requirements are explicitly gated.
The PR remains documentation-only and existing application checks are run by CI.
releaseBoundary: Research and governance documentation only; no runtime, dependency, database, or production change.
